category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
scenario_title: Academic frustration leading to disruptive talking
minimal_context: The student is asked to describe vocabulary game cards in English during a language lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at these vocabulary game cards. Please pick one and describe what you see in English.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gives a persistent inaudible response and shows an unwillingness to speak in the target language.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I couldn't hear you. What do you think?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows a lack of attention and motivation, struggling with difficulties expressing their ideas in English.) I don't know. I don't want to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this English activity. Please try.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits feelings of boredom and frustration by putting their head down to sleep in class, then suddenly sits up and begins disruptive talking with a classmate instead of participating.)
